svg.title: BICYCLE PARKING: SPACES AND COUNTS

g.text: FREE SPACE BEHIND — REQUIRED, NOT QUANTIFIED

svg.text: BFS 2026:4 (in force 2026-07-01). New flerbostadshus: at least two bicycle parking spaces per bostadslägenhet, plus a reasonable number for larger cycles
(2 kap. 2 §). New lokalbyggnad: spaces for at least 15 % of the average or 10 % of the total user capacity (2 kap. 4 §). On alteration the regulation
applies only to an ombyggnad that involves the electrical infrastructure where the car parking is in the building, or one done together with changes to car
parking on the plot (1 kap. 4 §); then the flerbostadshus count may be adapted if two per dwelling is not possible (3 kap. 1 §). From 2027-01-01 an
EXISTING lokalbyggnad with more than 20 car parking spaces inside the building must also have the 15 % / 10 % bicycle spaces (4 kap. 3-4 §§). A building is
a flerbostadshus if more than half its gross area is dwellings, otherwise a lokalbyggnad (1 kap. 7 §).
counts per dwelling / per user capacity, alteration triggers — https://rinfo.boverket.se/BFS2026-4/pdf/BFS2026-4.pdf
BFS 2026:4 1 kap. 7 § (definition of cykelparkeringsplats: the area a space is deemed to take if no special racks are provided), 2 kap. 2 § and 4 §
Data: data/catalogue/uses/shared_amenities.json → spaces / shared_bicycle_room. Drawn 2026-10-20 by docs/draw_standards_sheets.py. Diagrammatic, not to scale; figures and furniture without a
dimension are illustrative only. No values are taken from Neufert (catalogue policy: page references only).
